Baseline preserved unmodified: confirmed HEAD was exactly e6cb8c2 (UX-04 reopened #2) before any edit, all 8 named invariants intact, no AGENTS.md exists anywhere in the repo (confirmed via `find`), no SSE/event-store/persistence rework performed — every new surface consumes the existing WorkspaceState/TimelineEntry projection unmodified.

Sections track real data only: 'What Crado knows'/'Leading hypotheses'/'Recommended next test' each render nothing until the corresponding real correlation/hypothesis exists — never a placeholder implying content that isn't there yet.

src/lib/investigation/rank-hypotheses.ts: deterministic leading/plausible/weakened/unresolved ranking from the run's own real confidenceBand and update.status fields only — no invented percentage or score. src/lib/investigation/derive-workflow-state.ts: truthful workflow-state derivation (awaiting_measurement/idle/analysis_in_progress/analysis_failed/interrupted/more_evidence_needed/ready_for_next_test/change_ready_to_verify/outcome_ready_for_review/resolved) from real RunStatus + timeline engineering_change/result ordering + the failure_cases row's own status — 'resolved' is never inferred from an agent run finishing. AgentStatusPill now reads this instead of a 5-state Complete/Ready/Investigating vocabulary; wired end-to-end through page.tsx's real failureCase.status.

Both Decision and Map now render live from the same WorkspaceState during a run, so the forced tab-switch previously fired on RUN was removed — starting or re-running an investigation no longer yanks the engineer to a specific tab; whichever tab they're on keeps updating in place. Live-verified against a newly created Gateway X investigation (chrome-devtools MCP, no mocks): timestamped polling proved sequential arrival (t=0 activity item, t=4560ms hypothesis appears, t=4711ms run completes with the status pill flipping from 'Agent analysis in progress' to 'Ready for next test', never a bare 'Complete'); Decision and Map were both populated with real content during the run and remained fully populated after completion with no refresh; Map tab (React Flow) showed 5 real nodes post-completion without a reload, reconfirming the UX-04 reopened-#2 fix still holds.
Record result wired: the Decision view's RECORD RESULT button calls the same handleRecordResult the canvas already used, focusing the composer — verified live.

Responsive: 1440/1280/1024/768/390 all live-QA'd on the new Decision tab plus a Map-tab spot check; zero new console errors/warnings at any breakpoint (one pre-existing React Flow attribution dev warning, unrelated to this ticket, noted not a regression).

Tests: derive-workflow-state.test.ts (14 cases incl. boundary — a second engineering change after a result correctly reverts to change_ready_to_verify), rank-hypotheses.test.ts (10 cases), decision-view.test.tsx (7 cases — section presence tracks real data, ranking order, Record result wiring, most-recent-result selection), agent-status-pill.test.tsx (5 cases incl. the 'never bare Complete with open evidence gaps' and 'Resolved only when case record says so' assertions) — 36 new tests, all passing. investigation-workspace.test.tsx's pre-existing 24 tests updated (not weakened) for the new default tab and 'Investigation'->'Map' rename; full suite 408/409 unit tests pass (one case-composer.test.tsx failure is a pre-existing full-run timing flake, confirmed passing 14/14 in isolation, unrelated to any file this ticket touched). typecheck/lint/build all clean.

DEFERRED (not built this ticket, not silently dropped): the Investigations work-queue's four-bucket filters and literal per-row 'required next action' string; a dedicated Before/After comparison screen beyond the Decision view's Outcome section; a dedicated resolved-trajectory narrative view beyond Decision + the existing Timeline tab; Investigation Map minimap/jump-to-active-step control and its own Follow-agent-aware readable-default-zoom tuning pass; a real agent.tool.started durable event (no SDK lifecycle callback for per-tool active state was located this session — the honest overall 'Working…' state plus completed-tool-sequence was retained per the ticket's own explicit instruction, never synthesized client-side); a full WCAG/keyboard-navigation audit across the new Decision surface (basic heading/landmark structure and existing focus/live-region patterns were reused, not independently re-audited); cross-tab/cross-client run-start idempotency remains unenforced server-side, unchanged from UX-04 and explicitly out of scope per this ticket's own text since the run-start boundary was not touched.

CONTINUATION — Workstreams A/B/C shipped in full, D partially (queue filters). A: shadcn Sidebar (src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx) replaces the hand-rolled rail — Cmd/Ctrl+B toggle, collapsed icon mode with real aria-labels, off-canvas mobile Sheet, real destinations only, real open-investigations badge count, real Crado logo assets. B: New investigation now shows a real 'Recent investigations' section (recent-investigations.tsx) — real data ordered by latest activity, restrained generic DeviceGlyph (never a fabricated device icon — schema has no device-category data), truthful workflow state + required next action, one-click resume, loading/empty/error states. C: agent-activity-panel.tsx replaced by investigation-trace-panel.tsx — a real, live Investigation Trace populated by a new agent.tool.started event (additive migration 20260903000000_analysis_events_agent_tool_started.sql), bridged from the AI SDK's real onToolExecutionStart callback in investigateStreaming, threaded through the same canonical persisted-then-streamed SSE pipeline Decision/Map/status already use — a live run and a page-refresh replay produce an identical trace. D (partial): real queue filter buckets (Active/Needs evidence/Ready for review/Resolved) with real counts and a truthful required-next-action string, wired into /investigations via derive-queue-workflow-state.ts (a deliberately lighter, batched-input sibling of derive-workflow-state.ts, proven equivalent by its own 23-case suite).

TWO REAL BUGS FOUND AND FIXED VIA LIVE QA (the significant finding this session): (1) a duplicate React key crash — investigation-agent.ts was keying tool-call events by the AI SDK's event.callId, which the SDK documents as the *generation call's* id, shared by every tool executed within one model step (proven live: 5 tools called together in one step all shared one callId); fixed by using the real per-call event.toolCall.toolCallId instead, verified against real Anthropic toolu_... ids in analysis_events post-fix, plus a regression test scripting a multi-tool-in-one-step model turn and a defensive dedup-by-key backstop in investigation-trace-panel.tsx's buildSteps. (2) Immediately after fixing (1), a live run crashed with a real React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' — useElapsedTime's getSnapshot computed Date.now()-startedAt directly, violating useSyncExternalStore's contract that getSnapshot return a stable value between actual store changes; fixed by caching the elapsed value in a ref written once per interval tick. Tests: app-shell-chrome.test.tsx (10), device-glyph.test.tsx (4), derive-queue-workflow-state.test.ts (23), recent-investigations.test.tsx (6), investigation-trace-panel.test.tsx (14, incl. the duplicate-key regression) all new; investigation-agent.test.ts, run-analysis.test.ts, reconstruct.test.ts, investigation-workspace.test.tsx, describe-investigation-status.test.ts, create-analysis-run.integration.test.ts updated. Integration suite 62/62 (12 files). typecheck/lint/build all clean.

REAL DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED VIA LIVE QA: React 19 resets a form's uncontrolled fields once its useActionState action settles, silently clearing the typed email on every server-side error — caught by live-typing real credentials into a running dev server and watching the field go blank, not anticipated in advance. Password visibility toggle (src/lib/design/password-input.tsx) is genuinely keyboard-operable — live-verified via a real Tab+Enter sequence in the browser (not just a click), aria-pressed reflects state, accessible name states the action taken. Fields limited to exactly what the schema needs: no name/company/phone on sign-up, no password-confirmation field, no fabricated forgot-password link on sign-in (no reset flow exists in the codebase).

Absent flows deliberately not fabricated, recorded in docs/PROGRESS.md rather than built or silently skipped: forgot-password/password-reset, email-verification resend, workspace invitations, OAuth/SSO/magic-link sign-in, Privacy Policy/Terms of Service links (no such routes exist in the repo).
